authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: The existing donor audit transcribes the CSTT Hindi cabbage cell as बंदगोभी, supporting the whole band-gobhi compound. These survey forms preserve both members, allowing cluster simplification and g/k, b/p variation. The original donor-source fact is cached in the 20260911 audit; a fresh PDF fetch timed out. This provisional Hindi-family loan does not reconstruct the compound in Sanskrit. Existing Hindi bandgobʰī “cabbage” is the provisional donor, under the user’s preference to link supported cross-IA families. An intermediate Indo-Aryan language or another lending locality remains possible; the attestation locality is not claimed as the historical lending site.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4270 explicitly groups Hindi gobhī/gobī/kobhī/kopī and Nepali gobhi/gobi/kobi/kopi for cabbage, with Awadhi cauliflower. Platts independently attests gobhī/gobī and cross-refers kobī. Linking provisionally to the existing Hindi gobī attestation identifies the regional vegetable-word family while leaving competing ultimate plant-name derivations unresolved. Existing Hindi gobī “cabbage” is the provisional donor, under the user’s preference to link supported cross-IA families. An intermediate Indo-Aryan language or another lending locality remains possible; the attestation locality is not claimed as the historical lending site.
